read.thesis: Record Q4 with adjusted EBIT $338.6M and FY27 guide of 3-7% sales and 5-10% adj. EBITDA, but Q1-Q2 raw material inflation of 5-8% squeezes gross margin; supply discipline shows via plant consolidation and SG&A savings, not capacity cuts.

capex.quote: We anticipate capital expenditures to be roughly in line with what you saw in fiscal 2026 and 2025, probably in that $220 million+ to $240 million range.

triggers.label: Q4 price up ~2%, Q1 inflation 5-6%
triggers.quote: In the quarter, price was up about 2%.

triggers.label: Plant consolidation drag halves in FY27
triggers.quote: we think that, with some of the plant startups, it'll be about half of that will be a P&L headwind as we go through FY 2027.

triggers.label: Consumer volume down 2-3%, possible bottoming
triggers.quote: it does feel like after two years of a pretty steady single-digit negative declines in consumer takeaway and volume impact, that we're hitting bottom.

triggers.label: Working capital structurally improving
triggers.quote: we're going to continue to make progress on working capital like we have.

guidance.quote: Overall, we expect sales for the full year to increase 3%-7%.
Adjusted EBITDA is expected to increase 5%-10%.

guidance.metric: Q1 FY27 sales and adj. EBITDA
guidance.quote: all segments expected to grow in the mid-single-digit range.
SG&A-focused optimization actions are expected to generate around $75 million in benefits during the year.
probably in that $220 million+ to $240 million range.
For the second quarter, we expect inflation could be as high as 6%-8%.

red_flags.label: Supplier fire tightens PO/MDI raw materials
red_flags.quote: a fire at a supplier's plant has caused some tightness in propylene oxide-derived raw materials in North America.

red_flags.label: Consumer impairment $9.7M on Color Group
red_flags.quote: Adjusted EBIT excludes a $9.7 million non-cash impairment charge related to the Color Group.

evasions.quote: This is not the answer maybe you're looking for. I would call it a swag.
